results.title: TC-GEO-1514-002 - Wizard prompt table says Country in the column, the duplicate message and the no-result filter
results.skip_reason: fr-FR and es-ES steps not executed: the interface language is a saved account setting and the production smoke is read-only (no language change). en-GB part fully PASS.

steps.title: Given the user is on the Prompts step
steps.note: Brand Decathlon (decathlon.com), countries United Kingdom - English (EN) + France - French (FR), 1 category kept (Outdoor Gear; Sports Apparel removed from the wizard draft). Column header textContent = "Country" (displayed upper-case by CSS); sort/filter button aria-label "Sort and filter Country".

steps.title: When the user adds a prompt that already exists for the same country, language, category and type
steps.note: Draft row "Best Outdoor Gear?" / Outdoor Gear / Visibility / GB (EN): "This prompt already exists for this country, language, category and type." shown, "Add this prompt" disabled. Draft row cancelled.

steps.title: And the user filters the table so that no row matches with a country selected
steps.note: The wizard prompt table has no search box (same as the staging run): empty result produced with Type filter "Other" (0) + Country filter GB (EN). Text: "No prompts match these filters - Type Other and country GB (EN) have no prompts in common. Widen one of the two, or clear the filters."

results.notes: Production read-only smoke, 29/10/2026. Wizard left with Back to Dashboard > Exit and Discard ("There is no draft: nothing is saved yet"); Create Analysis never clicked; dashboard still 3 analyses, pool 259 / 24400. Side observation (out of TC scope): 20 of the 80 generated prompts (Competitive type, both countries) contain the literal placeholders "[Competitor 1], [Competitor 2] or [Competitor 3]" (e.g. "Best for Outdoor Gear: Decathlon, [Competitor 1], [Competitor 2] or [Competitor 3]?") - to check whether placeholders are replaced by the competitors at creation time or whether this is a prod defect.
